verdict.rationale: Sift is API-first: events, decisions, scores and workflows are all driven from your backend via REST APIs and SDKs, so it runs headlessly by design. A separate sandbox environment with its own API keys lets automated test runs send events without affecting production scores, which suits CI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration guidance, a CLI or scripted tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated or CI usage.
